About the AWP | Asiimov

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment The AWP | Asiimov is a Covert-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Asiimov finish on the AWP. With a Covert rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.26% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AWP | Asiimov can be unboxed from the Operation Phoenix Weapon Case. It belongs to the Phoenix Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.18 to 1.00. Due to its minimum float of 0.18, this skin cannot drop in Factory New condition. The best available condition is Field-Tested, which affects both availability and pricing. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AWP | Asiimov (Field-Tested) has a median market price of approximately $135.86, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $95.06 (Well-Worn) to $135.86 (Field-Tested).

Community Rating: The AWP | Asiimov has a community rating of 4.3 out of 5 based on 300 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AWP skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AWP | Asiimov?

Factory New (FN) AWP | Asiimov skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. Note: the AWP | Asiimov cannot drop in Factory New — its minimum float is 0.18, so the best available condition affects pricing significantly. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Asiimov pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AWP | Asiimov worth the price?

The AWP | Asiimov sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Asiimov design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Phoenix Collection, obtainable from the Operation Phoenix Weapon Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the AWP, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the AWP | Asiimov?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). This skin cannot be obtained in Factory New condition due to its minimum float of 0.18. The best possible condition is Field-Tested. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AWP | Asiimov?

Prices for the AWP | Asiimov vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Operation Phoenix Weapon Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the AWP | Asiimov in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AWP | Asiimov are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the AWP | Asiimov price going up or down?

The AWP | Asiimov has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the AWP | Asiimov from?

The AWP | Asiimov is part of the The Phoenix Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Operation Phoenix Weapon Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the AWP | Asiimov?

The in-game description reads: "High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment" The Asiimov finish on the AWP is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.

Do professional CS2 players use the AWP | Asiimov?

Yes, 9 professional CS2 players currently have the AWP | Asiimov in their inventory. Pro player adoption is a strong indicator of a skin's prestige and desirability in the community, and can positively influence its market value.
